proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding The Holy Land Principles
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board make all possible lawful efforts to implement and/or increase activity on eight Holy Land Principles on equal employment opportunity in Israel and Palestine.
proposals.evidence: ACCORDINGLY, YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Special Shareowner Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend bylaws to give holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: ACCORDINGLY, YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding an Independent Chair Policy
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board adopt a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: ACCORDINGLY, YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.
